sloka: कल्याणे बत न्क्षत्रे मयि जातोऽसि पुत्रक ।येन त्वया दशरथो गुणैराराधितः पिता ॥२-४-४०॥
transliteration: kalyāṇe bata nkṣatre mayi jāto'si putraka ।yena tvayā daśaratho guṇairārādhitaḥ pitā ॥2-4-40॥

translations.english: Addressed in this wise by his mother, Rama looked upon his brother, who sat bowing with joined palms, and said to him, smiling as it were:
